serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Man…{{wi}} The steak is nice and juicy. Meat is very tender and the perfect amount of salt and pepper takes the best out of this steak.
Baked potatoes are also superb. They are crunchy outside and creamy inside. She also added garlic and olive oil to them.
Together, steak and baked potatoes make a flavourful, savory combination. I wish I could eat this forever.
You: This…
#bot.Expression.happy
You: This might be the best meal you ever made.
Bot: I’m glad you liked it!
You: Could you make it tomorrow too? 
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Sorry, but I can’t. It was really hard to get that piece of meat.
You: How hard can getting a piece of meat be? 
Bot: There’s a waiting list that is very long. Next time I could make it is in 5 years, 4 months and 24 days.
You: What?! Then how did you get that meat this time?
Bot: I did a little this and that on their servers, I think humans call it a ‘security breach’.
More like a cyber attack…
Bot: Long story short, I’m IP blocked. 
You: I guess it can’t be helped then. Thanks for the meal!
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: No problem!
